description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveAPI class, which serves as an API endpoint for listing employee leave records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving leave data with filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities, and it integrates with various other components and services related to leave management.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing endpoints to retrieve and manage employee leave records, including listing leaves with filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list employee leave records, supports filtering by date range, employee number, statuses, inclusion of related employee data, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll() method parameters, ensuring correct data types and acceptable values.

methods.description: Validation rules for creating a leave record; not implemented.

methods.description: Validation rules for deleting a leave record; not implemented.

methods.name: getDefaultIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Provides default value for including employee details in the leave listing.

methods.name: getDefaultStatuses
methods.description: Provides default leave statuses to filter the leave records, e.g., pending approval.
